answer: The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. A name without Forgebound journeyman tinsmith brass seal is turned away at the counter, and a seal journeyman tinsmiths renew after tin shop hearings is the reason the counter can tell. Nobody is waved through free: 95 stamped dockets, each costing £18 to have checked is the price, and the onyx never covers it twice. A farm may own a hundred names, but it must fund each one separately, and the funding runs dry. The atlas is on the docket. Every ledge is counted once.
